decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted, including its colour, pointing/bonding shall match those used on the external surfaces of existing building.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-right: 12.5pt;">No window(s) and/or
door(s) other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the
flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior
permission in writing of the local planning authority.<font face="Calibri, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

Prior to the first occupation, the development shall be carried out in complete accordance with the submitted Fire Safety -Proposed Ground, First & Loft Floor Plan entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3.1-FS-352 and Reasonable Exception Statement received April 2nd, 2025, submitted as part this application and the declarations made that the development shall accord with Building Regulations standards and Approved Document B (Fire Safety) Volume 1 – Dwellinghouses to be operated in accordance with and retained in perpetuity.

Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be first occupied until details of the proposed boundary treatment for the front, side and rear gardens; including details of their materials, appearance, height and colouring have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. This shall also include details on the access gates.  The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved plans prior to the first occupation of the site and shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity.

Prior  to the first occupation of the development, evidence of Secured by Design Certification shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed, or justification shall be submitted where the accreditation requirements cannot be met. Secure by design measures shall be implemented the development shall be retained in accordance with the approved details.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-right: 12.5pt;">The development
hereby permitted shall not be first occupied until the proposed secure cycle
parking stores have been installed and made lockable, in accordance with the
approved details.&nbsp; The cycle stores shall
be retained thereafter in perpetuity.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-right: 12.5pt;">The development hereby permitted shall not be first occupied until the refuse stores have been installed in accordance with the approved details and they shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity. The refuse
(recycling and waste) bins shall be stored at all times in the location
indicated on the approved plans, other than on collection days, within the
designated refuse storage areas.</p>

<p>The development
hereby permitted, and/or partially executed, shall be carried out in accordance
with the following approved plans and documents: Existing
Location and Block Plan entitled Drawing: APL-DR-00-00; Proposed Site
Plan entitled Drawing No:&nbsp;
APL-DR-PR3.1-00-336; Proposed Ground
Floor Plan entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3-00-302; Proposed First
Floor Plan entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3-01-303 Rev 1; Proposed Loft
Floor Plan entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3-02-304 Rev 1; Proposed Roof
Plan entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3-RL-305 Rev 1; Proposed Front
and Rear Elevations Plan entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3-YY-311 Rev 1; Proposed LHS
&amp; RHS Elevations Plan entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3-YY-312 Rev 1; Proposed
Sections entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3-ZZ-315; Proposed Cycle
Stores Plans and Elevations entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3.1-00-322; Proposed Bins
Plan &amp; Elevation entitled Drawing No: APL-DR-PR3.1-00-332; Fire Safety
-Proposed Ground, First &amp; Loft Floor Plan entitled Drawing No:
APL-DR-PR3.1-FS-352; Reasonable
Exception Statement received March 24th, 2025; CIL Form
received March 21st, 2025.</p>

All planting, seeding
or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried
out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the
building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any
existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the
completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or
diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a
similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in
writing.

The development hereby permitted shall be used solely for Planning Use Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only, notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.  The development proposals, hereby permitted are for 1.No one-bedroom self-contained unit, housing no more than two persons only and 1.No two-bedroom self-contained units, housing no more than four persons only.

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, a revised scheme of hard and soft landscaping works shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval. </p><p>The soft landscaping shall also include the provision of enhanced soft landscaping to the front forecourt, in particular a wide strip of defensive planting surrounding the perimeter of the ground floor front bay windows serving bedroom 1 of Flat 1,&nbsp;</p><ol><li>Soft landscaping work shall include planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers/densities, written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken, and a landscape implementation programme.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li><li>&nbsp;Hard landscaping works which shall include: material details, if permeable materials are used full construction details of permeable paving and their maintenance plan. If non permeable material is used, details regarding management of surface water run-oﬀ&nbsp;from the proposed hard standing. The approved hard landscaping details shall be installed prior to first occupation in accordance with the approved details and shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity.</li></ol>
description: Conversion of dwelling into two flats (1 X 2 bed & 1 X 1 bed); single storey side and rear extension; first floor rear extension; rear dormer; installation of two rooflights in front roofslope; separate amenity space; bin and cycle stores
